import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda x: sum(v == x for row in grid for v in row))
    out = [[bg for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != bg and r + 1 < h:
                out[r + 1][c] = grid[r][c]
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
exec(code)
